value.rationale: Fixed points are a subset of cyclic vertices, so exact independence of each fixed-point indicator from the total cyclic count is a nontrivial structural cancellation. The all-order identity pinpoints how dependence returns: only through the feasibility threshold L_n>=r l. This single formula covers every cycle length and factorial order and yields exact signs and asymptotics, making it more than a routine marginal recomputation.
